root_idea.summary: The root centers on the division of a whole into two equal parts, with a related lexical line concerning parity, equitable dealing, and reciprocal service.
root_idea.development: The half-branch extends to reaching or becoming halfway, a midpoint, and things reduced or made half-ripe. The service branch develops into rendering or seeking another's due and acting equitably.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The normalized noun نِصْف is the public Quranic citation form.
It is the same Quranic lexical item نِصْف in an inflected occurrence and is subsumed under the public noun form.

senses.definition: One of two equal parts; half of a whole.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic usage, it denotes an allotted half in inheritance or marital compensation and half of a period such as the night; it may occur with a possessive or governing phrase.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical non-quantitative use distinct from the meaning “half.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act equitably toward someone; to give or secure that person's due, including by obtaining it from another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The person from whom the due is obtained may be introduced with مِنْ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The giving or rendering of what is right or due; equity in dealings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may describe reciprocal dealing in which benefits and harms are not taken or imposed beyond what is reciprocated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exact or obtain one's full due from another, so that the parties stand on an equal footing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may specify the person from whom the due is obtained with مِنْهُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become halved or reach the halfway point.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Classically said especially of the daytime when it has reached its midpoint.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Seeking equity or the rendering of one's due.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional verbal noun for requesting or pursuing fair treatment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reach or extend to the halfway point of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested of the daytime reaching its midpoint and of a garment reaching halfway along the leg.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place midway between two places; a midpoint or equidistant location.
A middle-aged person, between youth and old age.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Classical estimates in the evidence place this stage at roughly forty-five or fifty years of age.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a cooking expression, reduced by boiling until half of a beverage has evaporated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression عَلَى النِّصْفِ of wine or another beverage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A measure understood as half of a larger measure.
A woman's muffler or head covering.
The midpoint of a road or route.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression مَنْصَفُ الطريقِ, the halfway point of the road.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Juice, wine, or another beverage reduced by cooking until half has evaporated.
A date that is not wholly ripe; half-ripe.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied specifically to dates in the cited lexical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Half-bricks or cut bricks used beside whole bricks in building.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cut bricks are placed beside whole bricks, especially for ornamental arrangement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Reciprocal service in which a servant renders what he owes in exchange for the benefit he receives.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in a service relationship involving an exchange of obligations and benefits.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A servant who renders what he owes in exchange for the benefit he receives.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural cited for this use is نُصُف.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Form IV equitable treatment and securing another's due.
The noun for rendering what is right or due.
Obtaining justice for someone from a wrongdoer.
Obtaining one's due completely and restoring equality.
Beverage reduced until half has evaporated.
A place midway between two locations.
The middle-aged person or life stage.
A woman's muffler or head covering.
Diminutive pointer only; it adds no independent lexical branch.
A beverage reduced by cooking until half has gone.
A date that is not wholly ripe.
Cut half-bricks used beside whole bricks.

cautions: The QAC separates the seven occurrences into a six-occurrence nominal group and a one-occurrence T-tag group; both are presented under the normalized lexical noun نِصْف because the supplied form and context have the meaning “half.”
